name: 応答待ちのリポジトリ招待行
prompt:
Reframe the first supplied image (the registered v001 candidate) into the exact extremely wide shallow strip shown by the second supplied image (the original source crop). Preserve the existing row content, colors, avatar, Japanese labels, checkbox state, icon shapes, and horizontal positions. Do not redesign or add anything.

The final canvas must be a single 1017x97 proportion strip (10.48:1). The v001 image is 3:1 only because it contains large empty white bands above and below the row. Remove those bands completely and keep the same compact 97-pixel row height relative to its width. Place the thin top rule, checkbox, avatar, username/subtitle, pending invitation status and copy icon, and far-right remove action in the exact original horizontal arrangement. The row should occupy the full narrow height just as it does in the second source crop. Do not create another 3:1 canvas.

Use the first image only to preserve the Japanese recreation; use the second image as the authoritative geometry and crop. Output only the row strip, with no extra empty margins, table rows, page content, or browser chrome.
reviewNotes: Bounded second reframe attempt still returns a near-square canvas with large blank bands, materially wider than the required 1017x97 (10.48:1) row. Content and Japanese labels remain readable, but geometry is not faithful. Marked needs-correction; two attempts used.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
